summary: Steers the model toward a named look. The API takes a fixed enum, not free text: you cannot add your own preset or pass an arbitrary style word here. Stability's own schema notes that the list itself is subject to change on their side.
combines: Fixed for callers, not frozen forever: treat the 17 values as data that can shift under you, and fail soft on an unrecognised one rather than hard-coding an exhaustive switch.
Anything outside the enum belongs in the prompt instead, where Stability's (word:weight) syntax gives finer control than a preset does.
Documented on the control endpoints. It is the cheapest control on this provider: one dropdown, no change in request cost.
note: Make sure add a help tooltip value explaining all that in the ui.
